name: Riyal’s Ectoplasmic Shield
body:
School abjuration [force]; Level alchemist 3, cleric 3, magus 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (piece of green candle wax)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 round/level

DESCRIPTION

You are surrounded in wisps of green flames. Any incorporeal creature that attempts to touch you sustains 1d6 points of force damage +1 per caster level (to a maximum of +10). If the attacker has spell resistance, it applies to this effect. You take only half damage from an incorporeal attack. If the attack allows a saving throw for half damage, you take no damage on a successful save.
